original.prompt: Consider the following statements about the urban plan proposed in the Economic Survey released in January 2026:
items: It recommends that all million-plus cities adopt a 20-year statutory spatial-economic plan.
It proposes that such a plan be refreshed every ten years.
Land-value capture is one of the plan's three non-negotiables.
original.ask: Which of the statements given above are correct?
original.explain: Statement 2 is wrong because the Survey says the plan should be refreshed every five years, not every ten. Its other two non-negotiables are transport-first design and annual housing targets. Land-value capture is meant to stop public infrastructure projects from creating private windfalls.
original.source: All million-plus cities should adopt a 20-year statutory spatial-economic plan, refreshed every five years, with three non-negotiables: transport-first design, annual housing targets, and land-value capture so public infrastructure projects don't create private windfalls while city budgets stay stressed.
